whyItMatters: Insecure.MD5.hash computes MD5 in swift, whose collisions defeat any security reliance on the digest.
actions: Replace Insecure.MD5.hash with SHA256.hash wherever the digest protects passwords, signatures, or untrusted data.
For remaining checksum uses, add a comment stating MD5 is intentional and non-security.
Re-run the scan and confirm every remaining hit carries that justification.
verification: Rescan shows no unjustified Insecure.MD5.hash, and security digests verify under the replacement.
